metadata.title: AMC, Robinhood CEOs Feud Over Tokenization

content.text: Bloomberg's Anna Irrerea joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." AMC CEO Adam Aron traded barbs with Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev last week after discovering a token bearing the theater chain's name was trading on the brokerage's blockchain. AMC CEO dubbed it "outrageous" and demanded that Robinhood cease trading it.
